home.heroLead: We make polos, T-shirts and jerseywear for European and American brands. Every step, from dyed yarn to the packed export carton, happens inside our own group.

company.heroLead: Egytaltex was born in 2001 — Egyptian by ground, Italian by mindset. Twenty-five years on, we are a knitted-garment house in Cairo's Public Free Zone, making for brands in Europe and North America.
company.storyP1: We started with a simple conviction: that textiles made with care feel different in the hand and last longer in the wardrobe. From a modest beginning we built, step by step, a small vertical company — keeping yarn, fabric and garment under one roof.
company.storyP2: Operating from the Public Free Zone in Nasr City, Cairo, we pair Italian production know-how with competitive manufacturing in Egypt — quality, flexibility and cost efficiency in the same order. We do love what we do, and we do it our way.
company.quote: We are proud to say, not in a shy way, that we do it our way.
company.heroImageAlt: Looking up into a circular knitting machine and its yarn feeders
company.manifesto: Textiles made with care feel different in the hand — and last longer in the wardrobe.
company.groupTitle: One group, from yarn to export carton
company.groupLead: Every step of a garment happens inside our own group of companies, so quality answers to us alone.
company.groupHomeRole: Knitting, embroidery, garment making, washing & export
company.floorTitle: On the floor in the Free Zone
company.floorLead: Knitting, cutting, sewing, embroidery, washing and finishing all run in-house, so quality and timelines stay under our control.

floor.title: Knitting
floor.body: Circular machines for jersey and piqué; flat machines for matching collars and cuffs.

floor.title: Embroidery
floor.body: Two multi-head Barudan machines — 29 heads in all — for bulk runs and fine logos.

floor.title: Cutting
floor.body: An 8-metre cutting table, straight-knife cutters and conveyor fusing.

floor.title: Sewing
floor.body: Four sewing lines covering lockstitch, overlock, flatlock, flat seam, bar tack and hemming.

floor.title: Washing & finishing
floor.body: Garment washers and dryers, then vacuum ironing tables for a clean, settled finish.

floor.title: Inspection & packing
floor.body: Every order is inspected before it is folded, packed to spec and shipped.

company.machineryLead: More than 130 sewing and finishing machines, alongside our own knitting, embroidery and cutting rooms.
company.qualityLead: Quality is built into the process, not checked at the end. Every inspection follows documented procedures aligned with international garment quality standards.

qualitySteps.title: Inline inspection
qualitySteps.body: Checks during sewing catch faults while they can still be fixed at the machine.

qualitySteps.title: End-line inspection
qualitySteps.body: Each production line inspects its own garments as they come off the line.

qualitySteps.title: Final inspection
qualitySteps.body: A last check before packing and shipment, with a transparent report for the buyer.

company.visitTitle: Come and see how it's made
company.visitBody: Buyers and auditors are welcome on our floor in Nasr City. Book a visit, or ask for a virtual walkthrough.

products.featureBody: Most of what leaves our floor is polos and T-shirts in 100% cotton. A polo shows the whole chain at once: the piqué is knitted on our circular machines, the collar and cuffs on our flat machines, and the finished garment is washed for softness before it is packed.
products.customBody: If it can be knitted from cotton, ask us. Every client programme starts as a conversation.

clients.heroLead: We craft quietly for an elite clientele — brands and houses that value how a thing is made as much as how it looks.
clients.bodyTitle: Trusted by those who notice the details
clients.bodyText: Our clients return not for the lowest price, but for the surest quality. We work as a partner: developing programs, protecting standards, and delivering with the consistency a serious brand requires.
clients.sisterText: Egytaltex is part of a small family of aligned textile ventures, allowing us to keep more of the process close and our standards uncompromised.
clients.testimonialQuote: “They treat our product like their own. The hand-feel, the finishing, the consistency — it is exactly why we keep coming back.”

contact.heroLead: Whether you have a full programme or just a first idea, we'd love to hear about it. Tell us a little and we'll take it from there.
